text:
Ethan: quick callout  post-launch grooming: we have a customer-facing slow-path on long-context completions and two small UI tidy-ups. do we jam both into Thursday's hotpatch or split?
Sofia: slow-path is p0 for BigCo (their LLM flows time out). UI tidy-ups are: 1) compact history collapse, 2) tooltip alignment. both tiny but add QA.
Mira: QE only has a ~30hr hotpatch window. if we include both UI fixes we risk missing perf regression runs.
Tom: perf-first. reduce blast radius: include slow-path fix + hide compact history behind a flag. tooltip can go to mini-wave.
Ethan: can we feature-flag the collapse client-side so no backend changes?
Sofia: yes, client flag only. we'll default off in canary, enable for internal only.
Mira: rollout plan: canary Thu 08:00 UTC, run perf profiles for 2h, validate p95/p99. rollback if p95 increases > 12% or error-rate > 0.25%.
Tom: ops note: ensure we have a fast toggle to route BigCo to the previous code path if needed. I'll add `ops/toggles#fast-switch` to runbook.
Ethan: owners: Sofia -> slow-path PR + BigCo test fixture, Tom -> ops toggle + runbook, Mira -> QE plan and perf harness, Ethan -> release notes + CS draft.
release-bot: canary scheduled: v2.4.1-hotpatch -> Thu 08:00 UTC to group "canary-internal". checks: smoke, perf, error-rate, customer-specific validation.
Sofia: timeline: I can land flagged client collapse by Wed EOD and slow-path by Wed EOD too. need 1hr review from Mira.
Mira: I can review Wed 09:30 UTC. QE will include: 6 smoke cases, 3 perf scenarios (long-context), BigCo replay.
Tom: I'll add an alert: if BigCo error-rate > 0.15% during canary auto pause and page oncall.
Ethan: decision summary: ship slow-path fix in hotpatch, collapse feature-flagged (internal-only) in canary, tooltip to mini-wave. owners assigned. pre-canary sync Thu 07:30 UTC.
Sofia: :thumbsup: will prep PRs.
Mira: :white_check_mark: QE will be ready for canary window.
Tom: creating runbook snippet now.
Ethan: thanks all  ping me on thread if blockers.
